metadata.title: Leah Bennett: Where to Invest After the AI-Chip Stock Surge<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
The AI-chip trade will flatten out at some point, says Leah Bennett, chief investment strategist at Concurrent Asset Management, the investment arm of a $34 billion-asset wealth manager based in Tampa, Fla., but equities should continue to chug along, with industrials, healthcare and biotech names among the sectors reaching for the baton. “Earnings growth is going to continue to propel us forward,” she says.
